intro.text: A mistspren bonded to Dyel's mother, and before her to Ym.

items.text: Uma was bonded to Ym, an Iriali shoemaker who used the Surge of Progression to heal customers, passing it off as medicine. Nale killed Ym before he reached the Ideal that would let Uma become a Blade. Uma then bonded Ym's daughter and befriended her daughter Dyel, assuring Dyel that Baon was not Nale. When Dyel's mother was called on the Iriali Long Trail, Uma resolved to follow as far as possible.

appearance.text: In the Physical Realm Uma looks like a cluster of prism-scattered lights; in the Cognitive Realm a mistspren has misty skin, a porcelain mask and gloves.
